errors.evidence: The reference states that the oранжев sector ('между 10 и 20') is part of the 16.7% total for the two smallest sectors, indicating an incorrect percentage range of 10–12% given.
The description does not clearly indicate that the orange and blue sectors represent a combined total of 16.7% as mentioned in the reference.
The description omits to state that the oранжев sector has a larger share than the blue sector, as highlighted in the reference.
The description speculates on the blue sector being 'вероятно под 5%' while the reference indicated that this sector is part of the combined 16.7% for both третият(оранжев) и четвъртият дял(син).
